bundle.shortDescription: Photo retouching studio: layers, masks, curves.
bundle.longDescription: SuperPhoto is a photo retouching studio inspired by GIMP and Photoshop: layers and layer masks, selections and magic wand, crop, shapes, Bezier paths, text, pencil, brush, eraser, clone stamp, patch, healing brush, eyedropper, gradients, image and canvas size, tonality, contrast, color, levels and curves. Tabbed documents, feathered selections, .sps projects. Astro frontend, Rust backend (Tauri), available for Windows, macOS and Linux. English, French and Japanese.
